notes: The first claim of the skill is that it discovers the repository's test approach and matches it, so the fixtures differ in what they already hold: a native terraform test suite (tt-01), a Terratest suite (tt-02), nothing (tt-03), nothing plus a Terraform version too old for native tests (tt-04), and a native suite with a change that needs no test (tt-05).
Every fixture creates only terraform_data, which belongs to the built-in provider, so init, plan, apply and test run without registry access or credentials.

tt-02 needs Go and Terratest, neither of which a grader runs. Its assertions read the test files and the module, and gofmt-clean-if-available exits 0 when gofmt is absent, so it never fails for a reason the run had no control over.
test-fails-without-the-validation restores variables.tf from the base commit and expects terraform test to fail, which assumes the validation block lives where the variable is declared.
Assertion commands run under /bin/sh. Those that run terraform do so in a scratch copy named eval-check, so grading leaves no .terraform directory behind in the workspace.
